name: Tessl
tagline: Registry and governance layer for AI agent skills.
description: Tessl is an agent-enablement platform that lets teams build, share, version, and govern the reusable skills their AI coding agents rely on. It pairs a searchable registry of 3,000+ public skills (plus private workspaces) with a framework to author and test skills, security scanning and policy enforcement, and usage analytics. It integrates with agents including Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini.
insight: Founded by Snyk founder Guy Podjarny; raised $125M led by Index Ventures at a reported ~$750M valuation.
edge: A vendor-neutral skill registry that lets teams share, version, and govern agent skills across Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot — not tied to one assistant.

references.title: Snyk founder's new venture Tessl raises $125M
